data.title: 焰影苇草 · 花卉图鉴
data.description: 她在图鉴里找到花园里的植物，读完习性，又翻到下一页看相似的品种。
data.action: 低头细致翻阅湿润石桌上摊开的湿地水生花卉图鉴
data.camera: 中近景，书页与花卉插画清晰
data.promptProse: Reed sits quietly at an oak library table, carefully studying an open botanical encyclopedia filled with delicate watercolor depictions of marsh flora. A dried lavender blossom marks the adjacent page beside a brass reading lamp that casts gentle amber light across the paper.
data.animaCaption: Her fingertip follows the painted contours of a marshland wildflower in the open herbarium, absorbed in the quiet calm of the library.
